content.comment_body: Hello, is there any solution for commissioning communication between [product_name] and IO-Link sensors (sensors connected to an IO-Link master)? This might have to be done via Modbus. Thanks.

Hi, there is no direct way to achieve this. If the IO-Link master can exchange data with [product_name] using TCP/IP or Modbus TCP/IP, then communication should be possible. Please review the supported Modbus data formats in [product_name], since not all Modbus device formats are compatible. Hope this helps.
Hi [user_name], thanks for your response. I plan to check this IO-Link master: [url]
Hello, did you discover a solution for communicating with [product_name]? If so, could you share your approach? Thanks.

[product_name] cannot directly communicate with IO-Link. You need a gateway that supports both IO-Link and Ethernet TCP/IP using an appropriate protocol (such as Modbus TCP/IP). [product_name] can use Ethernet TCP/IP with the right protocol.
